mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, score, ai_suggestion, create_time, update_time, deleted, status, error_msg FROM assessment_result WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, score, ai_suggestion, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM assessment_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.questionnaire_id, q.title AS questionnaire_title, r.score, r.ai_suggestion, r.create_time, r.status, r.error_msg FROM assessment_result r LEFT JOIN questionnaire q ON r.questionnaire_id = q.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_result (user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, score, ai_suggestion) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionnaireId}, #{answers}, #{score}, #{aiSuggestion})
